intro:
Imagine a game where you're not just fighting against hordes of undead, but also using your creativity to draw your way to survival. Welcome to Zombies VS. Lines, a thrilling puzzle browser game by GamePix that combines the grim world of the zombie apocalypse with a unique 'draw one line' gameplay mechanic. This engaging and addicting game is perfect for players who love puzzle games, strategy, and a dash of adventure.

With Zombies VS. Lines, you embark on a journey to save the world from the undead, all while navigating through increasingly challenging quests and puzzles. The game's simple yet effective storytelling and charming graphics make it a must-play, even for casual gamers.

What sets Zombies VS. Lines apart from other puzzle games is its innovative gameplay mechanic. By drawing lines to create paths for your hero to follow, you must use your wits to outsmart the hordes of zombies and reach the next level. The game's controls are easy to use, with options for mouse, keyboard, or touch controls, making it accessible to players of all skill levels.

From the moment you start playing, you'll be hooked on the game's addictive gameplay and the sense of accomplishment that comes with completing each level. With a wide range of quests and puzzles to solve, Zombies VS. Lines offers hours of entertainment for players of all ages. So, if you're ready to draw your way to survival, then join the adventure and play Zombies VS. Lines today!
